beats.summary: Angela and Oscar argue about calling Senator Lipton to warn him about the documentary footage.

evidence.snippet:
Angela (Plays boom box to drown out sound): Alright, how much have you revealed on camera about your relationship with the senator?
Oscar: They caught us kissing on Halloween.
Angela: Oh! He was dressed like Ronald Reagan!
[STAGE] Slaps Osc

beats.summary: Pam and Brian discuss the documentary promos revealing private moments and lack of privacy over ten years.

evidence.snippet: Brian: They've got parabolic mikes, they can pick you up a hundred yards away, so…no if you were around there, they got you.

beats.summary: Jim and Ryan humorously read and act out a dramatic baseball-themed promo script involving Darth Vader.

evidence.snippet: Jim: "Together we will win this baseball game against the evil space Yankees. Eat Fresh."
Ryan Howard: "They kiss. It is super emotional. Like in Toy Story."

beats.summary: Dwight and Esther discuss the tractor lease deal and Esther's father's plan to lease it to others on weekends.

evidence.snippet: Esther: So you're going to be paying more, but he's putting on ten times the miles and he's pocketing a profit behind your back.

beats.summary: Angela and Oscar leave a message on Senator Lipton's voicemail, joking about the documentary outing him and Angela's infidelity.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Yes and I cheated on you with Dwight, it looks like they got it on film.
Oscar: Hey, I get the sense you're gonna be outed as gay.

beats.summary: Andy reacts emotionally to a negative comment on his video, while Nellie says good night.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Huh? Yeah, see ya. Oh! What?!

Angela: Call him! Call him!
Oscar: No!
